brands.name: Infinity Surfboards
brands.short_description: Dana Point, California surfboards from the Infinity / Boehne family shaping bay.

models.name: RAINBOW CHASER
models.description: Rainbow Chaser is a hybrid design by Dave Boehne. The outline is inspired by the Tombstone with a short length, wider width, and a wider tailblock for get-up-and-go speed and glide through flat sections. Quad fins add drive and control. Thin performance rails, low rocker, shallow single to an aggressive concave vee between the fins, and a diamond tail that shortens the rail line and adds grip.

models.name: LP
models.description: LP is Infinity's wide pintail longboard. It has a wider nose template and a thinner 50/50 rail with a hard edge at the fins for hard carves. It locks in nose rides through the section and also likes to steer from the nose. Best in longer LP sizes: 9'5", 9'8", 10'.

models.name: TOMBSTONE InfinFLEX Tech
models.description: This mini-Simmons style twin is Infinity's fastest planing surf vessel. The InfinFLEX version uses an EPS core vacuum-bagged with a carbon fiber and PVC hybrid construction for a light, durable, custom-tuned flex. A parallel outline and twin-fin keels cut drag. Blended deck, thin angular rails, rolled hull entry into a single concave exit.
